title: Portuguese Green Stew
description: A hearty stew featuring the best of Portugal with a vibrant twist. A perfect meal for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic, cook until softened.
Add carrots, potatoes, and zucchini, cook for 5 minutes.
Add green beans, cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add vibrant spice blend and stew seasoning, stir to combine.
Pour in enough water to cover the vegetables, bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, simmer for 20 minutes or until the vegetables are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
